description: This file provides functions to fetch a project's name via an API endpoint, with a fallback mechanism. It includes two exported functions: fetchProjectNameDirect and fetchProjectNameByProjectId, which are used to retrieve project names based on project IDs.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameDirect
methods.description: Fetches the project name directly using a specific API endpoint, with fallback to base URL if API client is unavailable.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameByProjectId
methods.description: Deprecated alias for fetchProjectNameDirect, retained for compatibility.
